summary.en: Hong Kong karatekas Grace and Howard first met as classmates in Class 1C at Lam Tai Fai College in 2004, bonding over their shared sport; twenty years later, both stood on the Asian Games podium in Nagoya. Grace, already a world champion and Olympic bronze medallist, added an Asian Games silver in women's individual kata, while 33-year-old Howard battled through years of setbacks — including being dropped from the Sports Institute — to claim two bronzes, including Hong Kong's first-ever men's individual kata medal.

summary.zh_hant: 劉慕裳與洪晧崴自2004年在林大輝中學1C班同窗相識，因空手道結緣，二十年後一同在名古屋亞運踏上頒獎台。劉慕裳早已是世界冠軍及奧運銅牌得主，今屆再添女子個人形銀牌；洪晧崴則歷經轉項、被踢出體院等波折，33歲終奪男子個人形及團體形兩面銅牌，創下香港空手道歷史。

summary.en: The Nagoya Asian Games eFootball tournament produced a farce when Qatar were marked 'DNS' (did not start) and forfeited their group opener to South Korea. Qatar said venue staff had led the team to the wrong lounge so they missed roll call, but Korea's protest was upheld. Qatar went on to lose to Saudi Arabia and Iran, exiting winless. Earlier, the Korean and Qatari football teams had also been driven to a baseball stadium by mistake.
summary.zh_hans: 名古屋亚运《eFootball》分组赛爆出乌龙，卡塔尔队因被工作人员带往错误休息室，未能按时检录，被赛会标注「DNS」并裁定韩国不战而胜。卡塔尔澄清选手已按时抵达场馆，惟申诉不果，其后两战再负沙特阿拉伯及伊朗，三战全败出局。值得一提的是，韩国与卡塔尔男足早前亦曾因司机迷路被错送往棒球场。
summary.zh_hant: 名古屋亞運《eFootball》分組賽爆出烏龍，卡塔爾隊因被工作人員帶往錯誤休息室，未能按時檢錄，被賽會標註「DNS」並裁定韓國不戰而勝。卡塔爾澄清選手已按時抵達場館，惟申訴不果，其後兩戰再負沙特阿拉伯及伊朗，三戰全敗出局。值得一提的是，韓國與卡塔爾男足早前亦曾因司機迷路被錯送往棒球場。

title.en: Esports farce at Asian Games: Qatar forfeit after staff lead team to wrong room

summary.en: Kan Cheuk-tung clocked 58.05 seconds to win bronze in the women's 100m butterfly at the Nagoya Asian Games, breaking Siobhan Haughey's Hong Kong record. She set personal bests twice in one day, in the heats and the final. The medal is her first individual Asian Games podium after a year of full-time training since graduating from university.
summary.zh_hans: 简绰桐在名古屋亚运女子100米蝶泳决赛游出58.05秒夺得铜牌，打破何诗蓓保持的58.12秒香港纪录。她在预赛及决赛一日内两度刷新个人最佳成绩。大学毕业后专注备战一年的她，终于赢得首面亚运个人项目奖牌，直言奖牌证明自己仍可进步。
summary.zh_hant: 簡綽桐在名古屋亞運女子100米蝶泳決賽游出58.05秒奪得銅牌，打破何詩蓓保持的58.12秒香港紀錄。她在初賽及決賽一日內兩度刷新個人最佳成績。大學畢業後專注備戰一年的她，終於贏得首面亞運個人項目獎牌，直言獎牌證明自己仍可進步。

title.en: Kan Cheuk-tung smashes Hong Kong record to win 100m butterfly bronze

summary.en: China's young women's volleyball team beat hosts Japan 3-0 (25-19, 25-20, 25-23) in the Nagoya Asian Games final, completing an Asian Games three-peat and a record-extending tenth title. After falling 1-7 (and 2-10) behind in the third set, China stormed back to win 25-23, with Wu Mengjie scoring a match-high 26 points. The win capped a 22-day turnaround after losing to Thailand in the Asian Championship final.

summary.en: Hong Kong's 'karate mum' marked her postpartum comeback by fighting through to the women's kumite under-50kg final at her fourth Asian Games. Scoreless against Malaysia's Shahmalarani Chandran after regulation, she lost on a unanimous judges' decision and settled for silver. Watched by her husband, a former Hong Kong international, and their young son, she said the medal left her with no regrets.

summary.en: China U23 drew 0-0 with the UAE in their final Asian Games group B match in Nagoya on September 23, finishing top of the group with five points from one win and two draws. Goalkeeper 李昊 made several crucial saves, including a key stop in the 78th minute, as tempers flared twice during the match. Forward 王钰栋 picked up a second yellow card of the tournament and will miss the quarter-final, where China face Thailand on September 26.

summary.en: China swept the men's and women's titles in the Asian Games debut of the half-marathon race walk over 21.0975km. Nineteen-year-old Shi Shengji won the men's race in 1:23:32, the 200th Asian Games gold in Chinese athletics history, while Yang Liujing took the women's title in 1:33:40 with Jiang Yunyan earning bronze.
summary.zh_hans: 21.0975公里的半程马拉松竞走首次亮相亚运会，中国队包揽男女金牌。19岁的石升吉以1小时23分32秒夺得男子冠军，这是中国田径在亚运史上的第200金；杨柳静以1小时33分40秒赢得女子冠军，姜蕴晏收获铜牌。
summary.zh_hant: 21.0975公里的半程馬拉松競走首次亮相亞運會，中國隊包攬男女金牌。19歲的石升吉以1小時23分32秒奪得男子冠軍，這是中國田徑在亞運史上的第200金；楊柳靜以1小時33分40秒贏得女子冠軍，姜蘊晏收穫銅牌。

title.en: China sweeps debut half-marathon race walking titles at Asian Games

summary.en: Hong Kong were beaten 0-13 by South Korea in Asian Games baseball, but their 24-year-old reliever produced the game's standout moment in the fifth inning. Summoned with two outs, he struck out KBO home-run king Kim Do-yeong — owner of 40 homers this season — with a curveball painting the edge of the zone, drawing huge cheers. He admitted he had been extremely nervous and credited his senior teammate's pitch-calling for the strikeout.
summary.zh_hans: 香港棒球队在亚运分组赛以0：13不敌韩国，但投手洪泓泽在第五局登板，面对今季轰出40支全垒打的韩职全垒打王金倒永，投出一记贴住好球带边缘的曲球将对方三振，全场欢呼。24岁的洪泓泽赛后坦言站上投手丘非常紧张，全靠学长引导配球才能解决打者。
summary.zh_hant: 香港棒球隊在亞運分組賽以0：13不敵韓國，但投手洪泓澤在第五局登板，面對今季轟出40支全壘打的韓職全壘打王金倒永，投出一記貼住好球帶邊緣的曲球將對方三振，全場歡呼。24歲的洪泓澤賽後坦言站上投手丘非常緊張，全靠學長引導配球才能解決打者。

title.en: Hong Kong pitcher strikes out Korean home-run king Kim Do-yeong

summary.en: Italy won the mixed team relay at the UCI Road World Championships in Montreal on Sept 22, triumphing over the 40.6km course. The mixed-gender relay rewards teamwork and precision, and the Italians delivered to take the rainbow jersey.

summary.en: China's national team finally assembled its full 28-man training squad on September 22 after the three Zhejiang FC internationals reported for duty in Chongqing. 塞尔吉尼奥 missed the camp through injury, 巴頓 withdrew hurt and goalkeeper 蹇韜 returned to Chengdu Rongcheng, with 19-year-old Guangzhou Leopards midfielder 黃晟豪 called up as cover. The squad is preparing for four international friendlies in Chongqing starting September 24.
summary.zh_hans: 国足9月22日随浙江队3名国脚到队，28人集训阵容终于集齐。塞尔吉尼奥因伤未报到、巴顿训练中受伤离队、门将蹇韬返回成都蓉城备战联赛，教练组紧急补招19岁广州豹中场黄晟豪。国足正全力备战9月24日起在重庆举行的4场国际A级热身赛。
summary.zh_hant: 國足9月22日隨浙江隊3名國腳到隊，28人集訓陣容終於集齊。塞爾吉尼奧因傷未報到、巴頓訓練中受傷離隊、門將蹇韜返回成都蓉城備戰聯賽，教練組緊急補招19歲廣州豹中場黃晟豪。國足正全力備戰9月24日起在重慶舉行的4場國際A級熱身賽。

title.en: China Complete 28-Man Training Squad as Teenager Huang Shenghao Earns Late Call-Up

summary.en: Eighteen-year-old Ma Tsz-ling enjoyed a dream Asian Games debut, setting personal bests in all three freestyle events she entered — the 100m, 200m and 400m — and breaking two minutes for the first time to finish fifth in the 200m final. The teenager idolises Siobhan Haughey so much she followed her to the University of Michigan, hoping one day to be fast in the pool and kind out of it, just like her.
summary.zh_hans: 18岁的马紫玲首次出战亚运即大放异彩，在100米、200米及400米自由泳三个项目全数刷新个人最佳成绩，200自决赛更首度游入2分钟内得第五。她视何诗蓓为偶像，更追随对方入读密芝根大学，盼有朝一日成为「游水又劲、性格又好又体贴」的人。
summary.zh_hant: 18歲的馬紫玲首次出戰亞運即大放異彩，在100米、200米及400米自由泳三個項目全數刷新個人最佳成績，200自決賽更首度游入2分鐘內得第五。她視何詩蓓為偶像，更追隨對方入讀密芝根大學，盼有朝一日成為「游水又勁、性格又好又體貼」的人。

title.en: Debutant, 18, smashes three personal bests and hopes to follow Haughey's path
